title: Intake Record
description: AI-extracted intake content only. Authoritative call identifiers, timestamps, node state, and transfer outcomes belong in the operational event envelope and must never be inferred by the extraction model. Every field is nullable because any question can be skipped and an early transfer produces a valid partial record.

language.description: Language the intake was actually conducted in after any GI-12 switch.

is_proxy.description: True when the caller is helping someone else. When true, every coverage and clinical field below describes the beneficiary, NOT the caller. Contact fields still describe the caller.

beneficiary_name.description: Name of the person seeking coverage when the caller is a proxy.

callback_consent.description: Consent for a human licensed-agent callback to callback_number for this insurance request only.

callback_preference.description: Preferred day/time, captured only on the early-exit path.

zip.$comment: Deliberately no regex. Vapi dropped regex support from analysisPlan schemas in June 2025, and more importantly a ZIP that fails validation gets discarded rather than captured - worse than storing whatever the caller actually said. Validate downstream if you need to.
zip.description: Five-digit ZIP as spoken. May be absent when the caller gave a county instead.

soa_consent.description: Verbal Scope of Appointment consent. Declined does NOT end the call - it suppresses plan-type naming for the rest of it.

soa_script_version.description: Exact approved SOA script version read on the call.

soa_product_scope.description: Product categories included in the recorded scope.

program_status.description: The main branch. Determines which follow-up was asked.

medicaid_renewal_timing.description: Dual-eligible branch only. Free text; 'not sure' is valid.

medicare_eligibility_timing.description: Medicaid-only and neither branches. Free text.

doctors.description: Verbatim as spoken. Never corrected or expanded to a formal name.

verbatim.description: Exactly what the caller said. Always populated.

name.description: Only when the caller said it clearly or spelled it. Never inferred from a partial.

dose_verbatim.description: Dose or directions exactly as spoken, including units, form, and schedule.

strength_value.description: Optional normalized value only when explicitly stated.

strength_unit.description: Unit exactly stated, such as mg, mcg, mL, units, tablet, or puff.

frequency.description: Directions or schedule exactly as spoken.

confidence.description: low = spell-back loop exhausted; the agent should re-confirm this one by voice.

other_concerns.description: Volunteered extras - dental, vision, travel, a specific drug.

flags.description: Things the receiving agent should know before they say hello.
